-121.95820,37.77720.name: Dr. Aimee Eyvazzadeh
-121.95820,37.77720.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-93.16669,45.07614.name: Boston Scientific Research and Technology Center (RTC)
-93.16669,45.07614.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Boston Scientific Corporation. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

18.57840,54.39325.name: Institute of Biotechnology
18.57840,54.39325.desc: A BSL3+ laboratory, operational. Run by University of Gdansk. It is categorised as a university laboratory, working on human health. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-47.81000,-21.17500.name: Oxitec do Brasil
-47.81000,-21.17500.desc: The Brazilian operation releasing engineered mosquitoes, where researchers later found the engineered lineage had introgressed into the wild population at Jacobina — which the company had said would not happen. The finding came from independent scientists, not from any monitoring programme attached to the release.
